findings.address_as_written: Resolution No. 209 - awards of contract, Palace of Fine Arts tennis courts
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners ratified contracts for the tennis courts at the Palace of Fine Arts: $5,451 to Eaton & Smith for regrading and resurfacing eleven courts and $1,327 to Malott & Peterson for a wearcoat on seven more.
